notes.title: San Camillo II is set to be release on October 1st
notes.content:
[h1]San Camillo II is set to be release on October 1st[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33419211/cf7a4b9defd19a3ec36680b59d6fc62f4f03bddf.jpg[/img]

The download of San Camillo II will be available on October 1st so be ready.
